# Demo evaluation set (synthetic)

These resumes and job descriptions were written by hand to test that
`scripts/evaluate.py` runs end to end. They are **not** real data and the
metrics they produce are **not** a benchmark of the system.

To measure real accuracy, collect real resumes, have a recruiter label each
one as fit (1) or not fit (0) for a job, and list them in a CSV with the
same columns as `labels.csv`.
